AZR_Exterior_Entrance.name: Azure Reach public entrance
AZR_Exterior_Entrance.text: Glossy world-class marine park entrance: architectural glass, water features, bright uniforms, families, influencers and sponsor signage. Expensive, beloved and visually effortless.

AZR_Ops_Room.name: Backstage operations room
AZR_Ops_Room.text: Clean technical operations room with readable monitors for water systems, guest counts, sponsor arrivals, weather and animal-care schedules. Competent and busy, never grimy or industrial-dystopian.

AZR_Media_Prep.name: Public media prep zone
AZR_Media_Prep.text: Ring lights, sponsor backdrop, turtle imagery and camera-ready branded surfaces near the public attraction, with clear staff circulation kept visible.

AZR_Glass_Corridor.name: Public/backstage glass corridor
AZR_Glass_Corridor.text: Bright glass corridor where glossy guest space and staff reality are simultaneously visible, ideal for ensemble staging and contrasting interpretations of the same event.

AZR_Guest_Experience.name: Guest Experience suite
AZR_Guest_Experience.text: Polished sponsor-facing meeting and briefing space with gift bags, presentation screens and controlled corporate hospitality.

AZR_Turtle_Public.name: Turtle Pavilion public zone
AZR_Turtle_Public.text: Beautiful public viewing area with clear habitat glass, branded signs, queue space and respectful viewing boundaries. Sea turtles remain calm, distant and safe.

AZR_Turtle_Backstage.name: Turtle Pavilion staff corridor
AZR_Turtle_Backstage.text: Clean staff-only care corridor beside the habitat with labeled gear, testing stations and unobstructed care pathways. Practical without heavy-labor or grime aesthetics.

AZR_Service_Corridor.name: Backstage service corridor
AZR_Service_Corridor.text: Compact clean service corridor where the ensemble can huddle under time pressure; readable doors, staff access and institutional signage.

AZR_Quiet_Viewing.name: Respectful Viewing / Quiet Window area
AZR_Quiet_Viewing.text: The Turtle Pavilion during the quiet window: softened but bright readable light, clear boundaries, calm guests and serene blue-water turtle habitat.

AZR_Break_Area.name: Backstage staff break area
AZR_Break_Area.text: Ordinary clean employee break area inside the polished park, used for decompression after public spectacle; practical tables, staff clutter and event leftovers.

AZR_Staff_Overlook.name: Staff overlook / loading dock
AZR_Staff_Overlook.text: Backstage overlook at day’s end with the glowing public park visible beyond; functional staff edge against an absurdly beautiful sunset.
